Refused at load: changed kept artifact -> artifact_changed; changed unpacked file -> tree_changed; kept .sig swapped -> signature_invalid; os plugin trust revoke -> signature_key_revoked; sandbox tier (installs with the warning) -> runtime_not_dispatched. (2) src/index.ts default-exported a factory, so the loader refused the install as not_a_plugin; it now default-exports the instance. Negative control: putting the old index.ts back fails the install case on exactly that refusal.",
